• Crypto total market cap fell 9.3% over 30D: Total crypto market cap at $2.61T (9.3% lower over 30D). Related: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty (CoinDesk).
  • Losses broadened among top-50 alts: 4 names up more than ~0.5%, 32 down more than ~0.5%, and 5 roughly flat out of 41 non-stable coins with a valid 1M % (top-50 table). Related: Binance Asks ArbitrumDAO to Release Frozen ETH and ARB (The Defiant).
  • Regulatory framing still decides product access: Enforcement and legislation shocks tend to pull risk into majors first, while higher-beta categories retrace until policy clarity returns. Related: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't (CoinDesk).
  • Listed ETF flows remain the cleanest demand gauge: Listed-product demand usually hits Bitcoin first, then filters into broader market beta if primary-market creations stay firm. Related: Bitcoin ETFs flip negative for 2026 after $1.28 billion outflow week, worst since June (The Block).
